work_completed: Added mvp/src/sandbox/operations.ts: sandbox-backed bash/read/write/edit operations, policy-reviewed, confined to a workspace root (lexical and symlink-aware), no host env forwarded, timeouts and size caps, fail closed.
Added @vercel/sandbox 3.6.1 (exact). Chose it over 3.9.0 because 3.7.0+ pull a transitive zod@4.1.11 that npm audit flags high; repo-wide npm audit is 0 vulnerabilities.
26 tests with a fake sandbox plus a type-level check against the real Sandbox type; 10 mutation checks each make the tests fail.
Found and fixed a hang: the walk up to the nearest existing ancestor could loop forever if the first path check were bypassed; it is now bounded by path depth.

Added mvp/src/gateway/free-models.ts: picks a free model from the live gateway catalog at use time (listed zero input/output price, all other price fields zero, not varies_by_provider, tool-use), fails closed with NoFreeModelError. 18 tests; checked against the live catalog (3 selectable on 2026-11-05).

Added mvp/src/sandbox/lifecycle.ts and vercel-client.ts: one fixed-name persistent sandbox via getOrCreate, one vCPU, deny-all network (exact-domain allowlist only), session capped at 40 minutes, and a lock so one turn runs at a time (18 tests including the lock script run in a real shell; 9 mutation checks each fail the tests; the SDK client is compile-checked against the real types).
blockers: Access control for the chat/agent route is undecided; the owner's answer (Vercel login for the model provider and model) does not say who can call the route.
decisions_made: Build the unwired library part first; do not add any route or sandbox creation until access control is decided.
Narrow SandboxLike interface, checked against the real Sandbox type.
Owner: Vercel login will be added after everything runs; the route ships off by default behind an owner-set flag.
Owner: the free account allows one sandbox, so the agent uses a single reused sandbox and serialises turns.
decisions_pending: Access control: Vercel Authentication for the project, a passphrase env var set by the owner, or other.
Approval defaults: proposed auto-run inside the sandbox, owner approval for anything that leaves it.
Egress policy: proposed deny-all by default; allowlist by explicit choice.
Sandbox cost against the owner's plan.

Real Hobby sandbox limits: docs say 10 concurrent sessions and a 45-minute cap, owner says 1 sandbox. Unverified until a sandbox is created; handle a limit error from getOrCreate as a clear 'sandbox unavailable' message.
handoff_record.next_agent_notes: Step 2 is a free gateway model driving these operations behind the crisis gate, streamed to the chat page, behind whatever access control the owner picks. Create sandboxes with networkPolicy deny-all and never pass host env or credentials into them. Keep the policy review inside the operations; do not add a path around it. Do not use @vercel/sandbox 3.7.0+ until the zod advisory chain is fixed. Timeout expiry behavior of sandbox.runCommand (rejects vs exit code 137) was not verified against a live sandbox. Step 2: Pi createAgentSession accepts customTools, noTools:'builtin', model, modelRuntime, sessionManager and settingsManager, so the sandbox operations can be passed via createBashToolDefinition etc. with in-memory session and settings. The gateway accepts the Vercel OIDC token as a Bearer token on /v1/chat/completions; read it with getVercelOidcToken() from @vercel/oidc inside the request (not at module level), pin it to 3.2.0 (the version @vercel/sandbox 3.6.1 uses; 3.6.0 to 4.0.5 is in an audited range). Pi's bundled vercel-ai-gateway model list is a snapshot and does not track free models, so build the model entry from the live catalog.
